name: spotify-mobile-test
description: Personal Chrome/Chromium WebExtension that injects a mobile-friendly player UI on top of the desktop Spotify Web Player (`https://open.spotify.com`).

scripts.test: npm run test:curation && npm run test:tippy && npm run test:stale && npm run test:lazy && npm run test:sheet && npm run test:fallback && npm run test:ui && npm run test:flaky
scripts.diagnose: node -e "console.log('Open tests/diagnose-playlists.html, then paste tests/diagnose-playlists.js into the Spotify tab console.')"
